- No way to group agent requests into logical "goals"
- Rate limiters built for humans failing on agent bursts Is this actually a problem you're facing? How common is this in production? or i'm not seeing this problem common because most of the AI agent still not in production and just in pilot or testing phase?

items.title: I built an AI that generates clean docs for vibe-coded apps
items.raw_excerpt: I love vibe coding. I hate writing docs. Every time I shipped something fast with Cursor / Replit / Antigravity, docs became the bottleneck. GitBook felt heavy, manual writing felt dishonest (the code kept changing), and most AI doc tools wanted me to “explain” my own code. So I built a small tool that does the opposite: Connects to a repo Reads the code + structure Infers architecture, flows, APIs, and components Outputs GitBook-style documentation automatically This started as a personal hack while shipping a side project. The first version was rough (hallucinated edge cases, weak on frontend state), but it already saved me hours per project. What surprised me: Repo structure matters more than comments Vibe-coded apps are harder to document than “clean” ones Docs don’t need to be perfect

items.title: AI进入推理主导的下半场，星宸科技押注哪5大赛道？

excerpt_i18n.zh: 要闻提示 1.突发！Meta 数十亿美元收购 Manus，肖弘将出任 Meta 副总裁 2.重磅收购！中芯国际：拟406亿元购买中芯北方49%股权 3.1月1日起，我国调整部分商品关税税率税目 4.一汽股权37.4亿元入股零跑汽车，朱江明回应 5.孙东旭卸任东方甄选珠海公司职务，此前他已退出新东方旗下多家公司 6.特斯拉申请限消车顶维权女车主：已生效 7.50亿美元联姻！NVIDIA正式收购Intel股份：超级SoC指日可待 8.17 岁少年利用 ChatGPT 编写恶意程序，窃取日本最大网咖 725 万会员信息 今日头条 突发！Meta 数十亿美元收购 Manus，肖弘将出任 Meta 副总裁 12月30日消息，Meta正式宣布收购新加坡AI智能体公司Manus的母公司蝴蝶效应，交易金额达数十亿美元，这是Meta成立以来第三大收购案，规模仅次于WhatsApp和Scale AI收购。Manus是全球首款通用型AI智能体产品，由中国团队Monica.im研发，核心优势在于能独立执行复杂任务并直接交付成果，而非仅提供建议。其采用规划、执行、验证三层多智能体协作架构，可调用代码编辑器、网页爬虫等23类工具链，在GAIA基准测试中以86.5%的准确率超越OpenAI同类产品，复杂任务处理能力提升23.7%。 自2025年3月上线后，Manus凭借高效的任务处理能力和用户友好界面迅速崛起，年化经常性收入（ARR）在12月中旬突破1亿美元，并以20%的月度增速扩张。根据 12 月初统计的数据，上线至今，Manus 已处理超过 147 万亿个 token，并创建了超过 8000 万台虚拟计算机。收购前，Manus正以20亿美元估值推进新一轮融资，但Meta以更高报价快速完成谈判，整个过程仅耗时十余天。 Meta表示，Manus将保持独立运营，团队继续驻扎新加坡，产品与订阅模式维持不变。

Today's Headlines
Breaking! Meta acquires Manus for billions of dollars; Xiao Hong to become Meta Vice President.
On December 30, Meta officially announced the acquisition of Butterfly Effect, the parent company of Singaporean AI agent firm Manus, in a deal worth billions of dollars. This marks Meta's third-largest acquisition since its founding, second only to WhatsApp and Scale AI. Manus, the world's first general-purpose AI agent product, was developed by the Chinese team Monica.im. Its core strength lies in independently executing complex tasks and delivering results directly, rather than merely offering suggestions. It employs a three-layer multi-agent collaboration architecture of planning, execution, and verification, capable of invoking code editors and web pages.
